items.title: CrowdStrike to shell out nearly $500M for 2 AI security startups as the market for securing agents takes off
items.summary: CrowdStrike said it will buy Fiddler AI, which makes AI agent observability software, and Dreadnode, which helps companies automate AI security testing.
items.creator: Ram Iyer

items.title: Anthropic is still grappling with the economics of compute
items.summary: At a moment when Anthropic's compute margins should be getting better, they’re getting worse.
items.creator: Russell Brandom

items.title: Ferrari’s controversial Luce EV is sold out for 2027
items.summary: The Luce, Ferrari's first electric car and one of its most polarizing models, is "fully allocated" through 2027, according to CEO Benedetto Vigna.
items.creator: Kirsten Korosec

items.title: Netflix’s new AI Discover tab helps you find something to watch based on your mood
items.summary: The first experimental feature under the tab will allow users to get recommendations based on what they're currently in the mood for.
items.creator: Aisha Malik
